responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(Default)] expansion by constructing AST impls of core::default::Default for aggregate types. This file synthesizes default() -> Self bodies that call Default::default on each field type for record and tuple structs, emits unit-struct constructors directly, threads trait bounds for generic parameters through setup_impl_generics, and reports derive-time diagnostics for enums and unions that this implementation does not support.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for Default derivation: it contains the code that builds default() bodies and surrounding core::default::Default impls for structs and tuple structs and emits diagnostics for unsupported forms, while rust-derive-default.h only provides the DeriveDefault class and helper declarations.
